mn2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn2:2.3: evambhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn2:3.1: jānato ahaṃ bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi no ajānato no apassato.
mn2:3.2: kiñca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
mn2:3.3: yoniso ca manasikāraṃ ayoniso ca manasikāraṃ.
mn2:3.4: ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva āsavā uppajjanti uppannā ca āsavā pavaḍḍhanti.
mn2:3.5: yoniso ca bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva āsavā na uppajjanti uppannā ca āsavā pahiyyanti.

mn2:5.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā dassanā pahātabbā.

mn2:6.1: katame ca bhikkhave dhammā na manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme manasikaroti.
mn2:6.2: yassa bhikkhave dhamme manasikaroto anuppanno vā kāmāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā kāmāsavo pavaḍḍhati
mn2:6.3: anuppanno vā bhavāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā bhavāsavo pavaḍḍhati
mn2:6.4: anuppanno vā avijjāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā avijjāsavo pavaḍḍhati

mn2:6.6: katame ca bhikkhave dhammā manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme na manasikaroti.
mn2:6.7: yassa bhikkhave dhamme manasikaroto anuppanno vā kāmāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā kāmāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:6.8: anuppanno vā bhavāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā bhavāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:6.9: anuppanno vā avijjāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā avijjāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:6.10: ime dhammā manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme na manasikaroti.
mn2:7.1: tassa amanasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ manasikārā manasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ amanasikārā anuppannā ceva āsavā uppajjanti uppannā ca āsavā pavaḍḍhanti.
mn2:7.3: ahosiṃ nu kho ahaṃ atītamaddhānaṃ na nu kho ahosiṃ atītamaddhānaṃ kiṃ nu kho ahosiṃ atītamaddhānaṃ kathaṃ nu kho ahosiṃ atītamaddhānaṃ kiṃ hutvā kiṃ ahosiṃ nu kho ahaṃ atītamaddhānaṃ
mn2:7.4: bhavissāmi nu kho ahaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ na nu kho bhavissāmi anāgatamaddhānaṃ kiṃ nu kho bhavissāmi anāgatamaddhānaṃ kathaṃ nu kho bhavissāmi anāgatamaddhānaṃ kiṃ hutvā kiṃ bhavissāmi nu kho ahaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti
mn2:7.5: etarahi vā paccuppannamaddhānaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ kathaṃkathī hoti
mn2:7.6: ahaṃ nu khosmi no nu khosmi kiṃ nu khosmi kathaṃ nu khosmi ayaṃ nu kho satto kuto āgato so kuhiṃ gāmī bhavissatīti.
mn2:8.1: tassa evaṃ ayoniso manasikaroto channaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ aññatarā diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.2: atthi me attāti vāssa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.3: natthi me attāti vāssa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.4: attanāva attānaṃ sañjānāmīti vāssa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.5: attanāva anattānaṃ sañjānāmīti vāssa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.6: anattanāva attānaṃ sañjānāmīti vāssa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati.
mn2:8.7: atha vā panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
mn2:8.8: yo me ayaṃ attāva vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇa pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
mn2:8.9: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ.
mn2:8.10: diṭṭhisaṃyojanasaṃyutto bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi
mn2:9.2: ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
mn2:9.3: manasikaraṇīye dhamme pajānāti amanasikaraṇīye dhamme pajānāti.
mn2:9.4: so manasikaraṇīye dhamme pajānanto amanasikaraṇīye dhamme pajānanto ye dhammā na manasikaraṇīyā te dhamme na manasikaroti. ye dhammā manasikaraṇīyā te dhamme manasikaroti.

mn2:10.2: yassa bhikkhave dhamme manasikaroto anuppanno vā kāmāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā kāmāsavo pavaḍḍhati
mn2:10.3: anuppanno vā bhavāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā bhavāsavo pavaḍḍhati
mn2:10.4: anuppanno vā avijjāsavo uppajjati uppanno vā avijjāsavo pavaḍḍhati
mn2:10.5: ime dhammā na manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme na manasikaroti.
mn2:10.6: katame ca bhikkhave dhammā manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme manasikaroti.
mn2:10.7: yassa bhikkhave dhamme manasikaroto anuppanno vā kāmāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā kāmāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:10.8: anuppanno vā bhavāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā bhavāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:10.9: anuppanno vā avijjāsavo na uppajjati uppanno vā avijjāsavo pahiyyati
mn2:10.10: ime dhammā manasikaraṇīyā ye dhamme manasikaroti.
mn2:10.11: tassa amanasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ amanasikārā manasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ manasikārā anuppannā ceva āsavā na uppajjanti uppannā ca āsavā pahiyyanti.
mn2:11.1: so idaṃ dukkhanti yoniso manasikaroti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yoniso manasikaroti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yoniso manasikaroti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yoniso manasikaroti.
mn2:11.2: tassa evaṃ yoniso manasikaroto tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahiyyanti
mn2:11.4: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā dassanā pahātabbā.
mn2:12.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā.
mn2:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhundriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.
mn2:12.3: yañhissa bhikkhave cakkhundriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā cakkhundriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:12.4: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso sotindriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati …pe… paṭisaṅkhā yoniso
mn2:12.9: yañhissa bhikkhave manindriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā manindriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:12.10: yañhissa bhikkhave saṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā saṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:12.11: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā.
mn2:13.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā.
mn2:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati
mn2:13.3: yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa makasa vātā tapa siriṃsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvadeva hirikopinapaṭicchādanatthaṃ.
mn2:14.2: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
mn2:15.2: yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa makasa vātā tapa siriṃsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvadeva utuparissayavinodanaṃ paṭisallānārāmatthaṃ.
mn2:16.2: yāvadeva uppannānaṃ veyyābādhikānaṃ vedanānaṃ paṭighātāya abyāpajjhaparamatāya.
mn2:17.1: yañhissa bhikkhave appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā paṭisevato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:17.2: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā.
mn2:18.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā.
mn2:18.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa makasa vātā tapasi riṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tippānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsikajātiko hoti.
mn2:18.3: yañhissa bhikkhave anadhivāsayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā adhivāsayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:18.4: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā.
mn2:19.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā.
mn2:19.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso caṇḍaṃ hatthiṃ parivajjeti caṇḍaṃ assaṃ parivajjeti caṇḍaṃ goṇaṃ parivajjeti caṇḍaṃ kukkuraṃ parivajjeti ahiṃ khāṇuṃ kaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ sobbhaṃ papātaṃ candanikaṃ oḷigallaṃ.
mn2:19.3: yathārūpe anāsane nisinnaṃ yathārūpe agocare carantaṃ yathārūpe pāpake mitte bhajantaṃ viññū sabrahmacārī pāpakesu ṭhānesu okappeyyuṃ. so tañca anāsanaṃ tañca agocaraṃ te ca pāpake mitte paṭisaṅkhā yoniso parivajjeti.
mn2:19.4: yañhissa bhikkhave apparivajjayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā parivajjayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:19.5: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā.
mn2:20.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā.
mn2:20.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṅgameti uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ …pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ …pe… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṅgameti.
mn2:20.3: yañhissa bhikkhave avinodayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā vinodayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:20.4: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā.
mn2:21.1: katame ca bhikkhave āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā.
mn2:21.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmaṃ
mn2:21.8: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmaṃ.
mn2:21.9: yañhissa bhikkhave abhāvayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā bhāvayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn2:21.10: ime vuccanti bhikkhave āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā.
mn2:22.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ye āsavā dassanā pahātabbā te dassanā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā te saṃvarā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā te paṭisevanā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā te adhivāsanā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā te parivajjanā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā te vinodanā pahīnā honti. ye āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā te bhāvanā pahīnā honti.
mn2:22.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbāsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati acchecchi taṇhaṃ vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
mn2:22.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
